Revised CFP: @ruma_sinha_1, @billieguarino, and I are seeking abstracts for our revised call for papers for Literary and Popular Cultural Reimaginings of #MeToo and South Asia. Please see full cfp here: https://t.co/WaoOor8gmU https://t.co/FmDscndbtJ
@shaynedelande_ Hi new friend, I am feminist and cultural critic scholar of #MeToo, the 1947 Partition, and literary as well as media and cinema studies. I also work as a Lecturer.

Boosting this post again! Please consider applying for our @northeastMLA panel on #MeToo and South Asia. The deadline has been extended to October 15th. We will also consider the abstracts for our edited volume.
And, working on my next writing project - a provocation essay for #MeToo and South Asia! Thank you @robinfield and @IyerNalini for this wonderful opportunity ☺️
So excited to have @yaldahamidi join us for Mapping the #MeToo movement at Home and in The World. We will be discussing activism within Iran, India, and the United States!

Adding to the thread: I met @yaldahamidi at @northeastMLA last year, and our conversations surrounding how in our respective countries #MeToo had not been successful. Moreover, the recent protests in Iran will also be in conversation in this event!
Looking forward to our event: Mapping the #MeToo movement In Home And The World in Nacerlio Commons tomorrow from 4:45-6 with @yaldahamidi, @K_Marino1! @sacredheartuniv

My sleep broke this last night - usually happens when I am on deadlines :) and I remember my mom used to tell me if I cannot sleep, then I should work on things, and I managed to write a good and thoughtful introduction for the #MeToo and South Asia essay I am working on!

Thank you @Mike19471985 for capturing the moments from our Mapping the #MeToo at Home and In the World panel! @K_Marino1 @yaldahamidi @WomenStudiesSHU @sacredheartuniv @SHU_HistoryDept @shuenglishdept https://t.co/LIoNridsh5
Finished the draft of #MeToo and South Asia essay! ☺️ such a good feeling - now just cut it down a little and then it will be ready to send. ☺️

Happy to share that we have received the book contract from Lexington Books for our edited volume: Literary and Popular Cultural Reimaginings of #MeToo and South Asia. We are extending the deadline to December 30, and only requiring a 300-350 word abstract and 2 pg CV!

Blasting the CFP call again - 300-350 word abstract and 2 page CV is due on December 30th :) for Literary and Popular Cultural Reimaginings of #MeToo and South Asia! Please see the cfp for more details!
